summary: EIP-8141 的规范清理合并：`sig.signer` 可留空并默认为 `tx.sender`，原始签名字节不进入任何 `sig_hash`，以便将来做签名聚合；内存池规则要求 expiry 验证 frame 只能是第一个 frame。chunter-cb 提交 EIP-8130 交易类型重新编号和 `eth_call`/`eth_estimateGas` 扩展。pcaversaccio 表示个人目标是让以太坊成为领先的隐私链。当晚召开 L1-zkEVM breakout #06 和 PQ Interop #47。

items.topic: 两条原生 AA 路线的规范推进
items.title: EIP-8141：规范清理与澄清
items.note: （morph-dev）合并。`sig.signer` 可以为空，默认是 `tx.sender`；所有 `sig_hash` 都省略原始 `sig.signature` 字节，因为交易有效要求所有签名有效，承诺 `sig.msg` 已间接承诺签名，若不省略将无法在未来做签名聚合；内存池方面，expiry 验证 frame 只能是 frame 列表中的第一个。
items.note_en: (morph-dev), merged. `sig.signer` can be empty and defaults to `tx.sender`; raw `sig.signature` bytes are elided from every `sig_hash`, because a transaction is valid only if all signatures are valid, so committing to `sig.msg` already commits to the signatures indirectly, and keeping the bytes would rule out future signature aggregation; in the mempool, the expiry verifier frame can only be the first frame in the list.
items.topic_en: Spec progress on both native AA paths

items.topic: 两条原生 AA 路线的规范推进
items.title: EIP-8130：重新编号 AA 交易类型并加入 eth_call/eth_estimateGas RPC 扩展
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。`AA_TX_TYPE` 从 `0x7B` 改为 `0x79`，`AA_PAYER_TYPE` 从 `0x7C` 改为 `0x7A`；RPC 接受 AA 交易字段（`sender`、`nonceKey`、`accountChanges`、`calls`、`expiry`、`payer` 等）并按 AA 交易计价，认证 gas 取决于认证数据的形状而非有效签名。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: renumber AA transaction types and add an eth_call/eth_estimateGas RPC extension
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. `AA_TX_TYPE` goes from `0x7B` to `0x79` and `AA_PAYER_TYPE` from `0x7C` to `0x7A`; the RPC accepts the AA transaction fields (`sender`, `nonceKey`, `accountChanges`, `calls`, `expiry`, `payer` and more) and prices the request as an AA transaction, since authentication gas depends on the auth blob's shape rather than a valid signature.
items.topic_en: Spec progress on both native AA paths

keywords_en: signature bytes kept out of the signing hash
expiry verifier frame must come first
summary_en: An EIP-8141 spec cleanup was merged: `sig.signer` may be empty and defaults to `tx.sender`, raw signature bytes are left out of every `sig_hash` so signatures can be aggregated later, and the mempool rules require the expiry verifier frame to be the first frame. chunter-cb submitted an EIP-8130 renumbering of transaction types and an `eth_call`/`eth_estimateGas` extension. pcaversaccio said his personal goal is to make Ethereum the leading privacy chain. L1-zkEVM breakout #06 and PQ Interop #47 were held in the evening.
